title: Nights of a Resort Lodging Stay Already Carrying a Resort Charge
content:
A night of a Resort Lodging stay already charged is never charged twice. The resort charge entries standing on the reservation's folio are read against the nights the charge is worked out over, and only what those entries do not already cover is charged.

Where the folio carries resort charge entries for the stay covering some but not all of the nights the charge is worked out over, only the nights those entries do not cover are charged, that is the nights the charge is worked out over less the nights those entries cover.

Where the folio carries resort charge entries covering every one of those nights, no night is charged again.

Where the folio carries no resort charge entry for the stay, every one of those nights is charged.

| What the folio's resort charge entries cover | The nights charged |
| --- | --- |
| Some but not all of the nights the charge is worked out over | the nights worked out over, less the nights those entries cover |
| Every one of those nights | none |
| No night at all | every one of those nights |

### Three hypothetical folios, where the charge is worked out over 7 nights

A folio carrying resort charge entries covering 4 nights covers some but not all of the 7, so 3 nights are charged.

A folio carrying resort charge entries covering 7 nights covers every one of them, so no night is charged again; and a folio whose entries cover 9 nights likewise covers every one of the 7, so again no night is charged again.

A folio carrying no resort charge entry for the stay has all 7 nights charged.
